g.title:
WayBuddy is a transport and navigation app designed to help users navigate unfamiliar destinations using public transportation.
The idea came from a simple observation: getting somewhere unfamiliar by public transport often requires more than knowing where the destination is. Users need to know which route to take, where to board, when to get off, how much the journey might cost, and what to expect along the way.
WayBuddy brings these pieces together into a single, easy-to-follow journey experience.
